seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Player moves 3 px per arrow (1 up, 2 down, 3 left, 4 right), but only inside an inferred invisible FLOOR: room x30-59,y30-59 plus corridor x6-29,y42-50, checked pixel by pixel.
If the player's next rect would overlap a block, the player stays put and kicks it. The push-chain group slides 3 px per tick and stops when any member would leave the floor, hit the player, or enter a socket interior (bbox minus 1 px border) of a different size.
Clicking a block makes it the player (the player takes its rect) and the old player vanishes. Blocks are renamed token_i by (y,x) after every move.
terrain, portal and socket objects never change and are treated as static scenery. The terrain pixels do not match the floor, so the floor is inferred.
Not confirmed by the data: a block entering a socket that fits it, actions 5 and 7, and clicks on non-block cells (treated as no-ops). Passes 29/29 statelessly.
